comments: Registered as one bank on the footing line (the pivot x is the centre of the footing stones); the drawings differ by up to four source pixels in height, the tallest sets the one shared scale. The house is painted 67 of 80 px wide; nothing is stretched, so it stands centred on its footprint with grass showing about six pixels at each side.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the palette snap had sent brown-grey flecks (source about 826344) to an olive ink (69793e) and the dark brown outline (source about 221d1d) to a dark green one (182414); the grade maps those two admitted shared inks to the browns 684629 and 25140b; no pixel is moved, added or removed.
geometry: The footprint, the door tile and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: day-0, night-0 (shuttered ground floor, indigo glass), lit-0 (amber windows, ajar door). The measurer's note that the drawings nearly touch was checked against the sheet's alpha: the crops are tight and the empty columns 509-515 and 1015-1021 separate them, so none is merged.

size_basis: native canvas 80x76, anchor bottom-centre (40,76); the bottom edge is the footprint's south edge; stage 384x224; a knight is 16x24 in this town; buildings may stand taller than their footprint.
